correctness.rationale: For k=2 and supported candidates, a violating JR group S is unrepresented by an optimal pair; choosing a shared d of quality gamma>=n/[2(n-1)] and retaining the highest-quality original a satisfies JR. Any violating group T for {a,d} would be disjoint from S; both have size >=n/2, and the equality case contradicts that a has a supporter outside S. The exact quality inequality factors into nonnegative terms. EJR 2-seat claims require S=V and two unanimously approved unit-quality candidates, which can form an optimal committee; otherwise EJR=JR. The 3-candidate two-party profile exactly attains the finite-n boundary. The packaged exact-rational checker passed 24,407 checks and was run from the actual package path; no inference from finite checks is needed for universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The result completely determines the exact quality-price for every fixed electorate size in the canonical two-seat, supported-candidate reciprocal-JR and reciprocal-EJR model. It quantifies the finite-sample correction to the known asymptotic 3/4 limit (n=2 -> 1, n=3 -> 7/8, n=4 -> 5/6), proves a constructive single-candidate replacement suffices, and identifies when the stronger EJR has exactly the same optimal quality. All n are classified, rather than arbitrary isolated inventories or rebranded quality floors.
